Row.Text: Destiny produces the man for the hour. The Cuban destiny has produced me, and I cannot help but wonder what destiny produced you.
Condemn me, it does not matter: history will absolve me.
Greetings comrade.
I sympathize with your people, oppressed and abused. You, I despise.
Greetings comrade. The repugnant imperialists will soon face the full force of our revolution.
Warfare is a means and not an end. Warfare is a tool of revolutionaries. The important thing is the revolution, and it is this revolution that we will bring to free your people!
The workers of your land are abused and exploited by your disgusting greed. I will bring them liberty.
The Cuban people are prepared to sacrifice themselves for the cause of the destruction of imperialism and the victory of world revolution.
If I had admitted what I was upon the mountains where we met, I don't believe I would have been able to descend to the plains. Now that you've helped me down, you're no longer needed.
I think that a man should not live beyond the age when he begins to deteriorate. The flame that burned brightest in your life has weakened, and I will put it out.
I expected this from imperialist scum such as yourself.
A revolution cannot succeed without the will of the people. My people offer you this. Do you accept?

Every revolution is a battle between the future and the past. Cuba is the future. You... well, I'm certain you can guess.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]([COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]They have publicly denounced us! NOTE: You are not at war.[ENDCOLOR])
I knew a man, a great man, who said that those who tremble indignation at every injustice was a comrade. Do you tremble? Are you a friend? Are you too free?
A revolution is not a trail of roses, it is a fight to the death between the future and the past. I will not stop this revolution until your empire is history and your people are free.

A revolution is a struggle between the exploited and the exploiters. Your exploitation of {@1_MinorCivName} is intolerable. If you do not refrain from such hostility, I will have to rally the exploited and improverished against you.
Greetings comrade! I am glad to see you too believe that capitalism is obsolete. Let us combine our forces and liberate the world from tyranny!
Trying to sow dissent aren't you? No one does so better than myself. If you do not remove your operatives from my cities, your own people will be attempting to kill you.
In Cuba, there is a commitee in every corner and a revolution in every neighborhood. What made you think your pathetic spy could sneak in unharmed?
A revolution cannot succeed without sacrifice. I mourn for my fallen comrade.
